text:
ben: Morning postmortem notes — saw a burst of handshake timeouts and truncated/partial responses on the streaming/chat endpoint for a subset of sessions (~40).
sam: confirmed. clients observed incomplete chunks then automatic reconnects. grabbing full traces and client logs.
incident-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0421-streaming-partials. Severity: P2 (monitoring).
maria: quick timeline: 09:11 initial timeout uptick -> 09:13 partial payloads spike -> 09:22 gradual recovery; no deploys during window.
kai: initial hypothesis: simultaneous long-context streams caused KV cache churn + eviction storms, increasing handshake latency. sharing request length histogram.
ben: Proposed action items (short):
  A1) client handshake backoff bump and short-term rollout (owner: sam) — change 5s->10s backoff for VIPs, can revert. target: 2026-04-24
  A2) server-side partial-chunk detection + alerting (owner: maria) — metric, dashboard tile, PagerDuty rule. target: 2026-04-26
  A3) KV eviction root-cause repro + heap/profile capture (owner: kai) — run generator, collect profiles, file findings. target: 2026-04-29
  A4) gateway retry window with circuit-breaker (owners: sam + maria) — add bounded retries + CB watching CPU/queue depth. target: 2026-04-28
  A5) 90-day recurrence scan for partial/timeout signatures (owner: maria) — group by root cause and tag historical owners. target: 2026-04-30
sam: I'll take A1. Test plan: push backoff to staging, run 24h smoke, monitor error-rate, reconnection latency, and user-visible truncation.
  - staging test (example): curl -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"stream":true,"max_tokens":4096}' https://staging.api.redwood/chat/stream
maria: For A2 I'll add SLO alert: if partial_chunk_ratio > 0.35% over 15m -> page eng-sre. Also a dashboard tile showing partials per 1k requests and per-model breakdown.
kai: Reproducer plan for A3: open 300 concurrent streams with mixed prefix lengths and force KV churn. Config snippet:
```
clients: 300
mix: short=70%, long=30%
arrival: poisson(0.8s)
kv_pattern: churn-heavy
duration: 20m
metrics: collect heap, GC, kv-eviction-count
```
ben: For A4 let's cap retries to 2 extra attempts with exponential backoff and gate them behind a CB: trigger if CPU>70% or queue_depth>800. We should instrument queue depth per route.
sam: note — excessive retries could amplify load. we'll validate in staging with load tests and watch backend queueing latencies.
maria: I'll own A5 and run the 90d scan. Deliverable: short doc with clusters of incidents, common signatures, and suggested owners. will link here.
incident-bot: Actions updated: A1->sam, A2->maria, A3->kai, A4->sam+maria, A5->maria.
sam: check-in: aiming to push client backoff patch to staging by EOD and post results here.
maria: will publish the 90d recurrence doc to #incidents and attach the dashboard snapshots.
kai: will drop repro logs, heap profiles, and perf charts into the runbook channel when ready.
ben: scheduling follow-up sync Friday 10:00am PT to review rollouts and decide whether to promote or rollback. if regressions occur before then, ping @sam and @maria immediately.
sam: :thumbsup:
maria: :+1:
kai: starting generator now and will post intermediate logs.
incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-0421 status -> monitoring."
